title: Polygenic risk scores and plasma proteomics identify cancer-related proteins and trans-regulated protein networks.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.21231314 via its API: one file, a 12,765-byte zip of the GitHub code. GitHub repo diptavo/cancer_PRS_Manuscript listing: R scripts only. Europe PMC supplement listing timed out and was not retried.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Data availability statement: ARIC (Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities) genotype, phenotype and proteomic data (4,955 plasma proteins) are controlled access through dbGaP (NCBI's database of genotypes and phenotypes) phs000280.v3.p1; 'This study did not generate new data.' Result counts (90 protein associations, 19 network components over 433 proteins) are from the abstract.

a1_downloadable.note: Individual-level genotypes and proteomics are controlled access via dbGaP phs000280 and need an access application; checked that Zenodo/GitHub hold only code. Supplementary summary tables were not retrievable (Europe PMC timeout).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked in files. Any label (a protein level, or a PRS-protein association) would come from the controlled-access data or would have to be computed from summary statistics.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs (genotypes, proteins) are not public; only from paper text.

a5_enough_rows.note: Participant count not verified; the public results would be ~90 associations, which is too few.

a8_label_provenance.note: The public outputs (pQTS, the protein quantitative trait score, and ARCHIE components) are statistical model outputs computed from PRS (polygenic risk scores) and proteins, not physical measurements.

honest_claim_h3: Not reachable: the measurements needed to train anything are controlled access, and the public outputs are a small set of statistical associations.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use inherited cancer risk scores to predict blood protein levels in people without cancer.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-person genetic risk scores for 21 cancers plus 4,955 plasma protein levels from the ARIC study; number of people unknown (not verified).
plain_idea.predict: Measured plasma protein levels (from an aptamer-based proteomics assay) in ARIC participants.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could point to circulating proteins that link inherited cancer risk to biology, but the data is behind a dbGaP application.

ml_idea: Predict plasma protein levels from cancer PRS; blocked because ARIC individual-level data is dbGaP controlled access.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Data availability statement already kills it: dbGaP phs000280 controlled access.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: ARIC genotype and proteomic data are controlled access through dbGaP (phs000280.v3.p1, needs an application), and the Zenodo deposit is only a 12.7 KB code zip. Flag as controlled access; the public outputs (~90 associations) are model outputs and too few to train on.
